migration.description: Online durable-state control and legacy observation migration for global content processing.
migration.release_unit_description: Single-instance Compose/SQLite release with no topology change.

durable_state.description: SQLx migration history, global content-processing tables, legacy observation rows and runtime-owner leases.

source_compatibility_range.existing_history_behavior: validate-only; pending SQLx migrations are not applied to an existing database

ddl_structural_changes.description: Create online migration lease, run and operation control tables and indexes.

dml_changes.description: Repair historical content_processing_control values to global without changing legacy facts.

historical_data_backfill_or_transformati.description: Record unobserved legacy translation_work_items and ai_translations rows in batches of at most 100; durable observation absence is the completion predicate and SQLite rowid is retained only as an informational progress cursor. Legacy work or non-displayable cache evidence is classified as legacy_conflict, while only displayable ready cache evidence is legacy_cached.

required_test_evidence: existing history version checksum and dirty validation
pause resume cursor and interruption re-entry
valid content submission during legacy and rollback_freeze
foreground write priority and live-owner recovery
